title: Cook cafeteria v2 maps for live flashlight teleop
objective: Cook/package the local SPEAR build so live examples/flashlight/run.py can load the cafeteria_500sqft_v2 maps, especially /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark.
instructions: Use existing repository scripts/docs to cook/package cafeteria_500sqft_v2 content for the local SPEAR runtime; do not edit product source.

Include both map paths if supported: /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark.
Launch any long-running Unreal/SPEAR process in a named tmux session and write durable command/log/status files under a clearly named .control-tower/runs/ directory.
Monitor until the cook/package process completes, fails, or reaches a clear blocker; return exact commands, tmux attach command, log paths, exit status, and produced package/build location.
After cooking, perform a lightweight availability check if feasible without starting an extended live teleop session; otherwise report the exact teleop command the user should rerun.
constraints: Do not modify product source, tests, or docs.
Do not delete unrelated generated assets or runtime state.
expected_outputs: Experimenter ResultPacket with cook/package status, logs, tmux session, output location, and next command for live teleop.
definition_of_done: The cafeteria_500sqft_v2 dark validation map is cooked/packaged into the local SPEAR runtime, or a concrete blocker with log evidence is reported.
